a.content: The RP2350 supports 1 MHz to 50 MHz crystals.
a.source: The Crystal Oscillator (XOSC) uses an external crystal to produce an accurate reference clock. RP2350 supports 1 MHz to 50 MHz crystals and the RP2350 reference design uses a 12 MHz crystal.

b.source: The Crystal Oscillator (XOSC) uses an external crystal to produce an accurate reference clock. The RP2040 supports 1MHz to 15MHz crystals and the RP2040 reference design uses a 12MHz crystal.

notes: The central negative of the vertical corpus. Same unit, same slot, different values, near-identical surrounding prose, and DIFFERENT PARTS. A findings report that flags this is telling an engineer that two datasheets disagree when they simply describe two microcontrollers.
